reviews.title: Impressed! Perfect for summer
reviews.body: These sunglasses are spectacular, i am very impressed for the price point. Affordable, good quality, lightweight, and fit perfectly! I have very sensitive eyes, so I have to be very picky about the sunglasses I wear, usually having to spend $$ for a good pair. These pass the test, at a fraction of the cost. The lenses are polarized and block the sun fairly well. Wore these on a walk as soon as I bought them, and I am already wanting to buy another pair!! definitely recommend, if you are looking for something that is sleek, but fun. Can also be a great gift!! Love the variety of color options!

reviews.author: kate

reviews.title: Love, love, love these sunglasses!
reviews.body: I love Goodr sunglasses! I'm so fortunate to have found them. They're comfortable and they stay on my face and they look good while doing it! Oh, and they have the most awesome names that're so fun to share with people who admire my shades.But perhaps my favorite part of Goodr sunglasses is the affordability. I used to get sunglasses that were $300±. I'd be so scared to wear them because I didn't want to damage or lose them. I can get a dozen pairs of Goodr sunglasses for the same price.And why wouldn't I get myself a dozen pairs of Goodr sunglasses? I don't have to worry about scratching them or losing them because I've got 11 more pairs. And I don't have to choose between colors or styles. I can get all the ones I like!And when it comes right down to it what more can you ask for in a pair, or a dozen pairs, of sunglasses?
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026
reviews.author: Stacey Gibbings

reviews.title: Great quality, durable, and stylish
reviews.body: Goodr are some of the best sunglasses you can buy at this price point, whether you’re an athlete or just want them for casual use. I love the matte black finish, which is just a touch lighter than my own soul :). The polarization and general glare reduction have been great on extra sunny days. I recently dropped them from my head on concrete or asphalt, and even though a lens popped out, I was able to get it back in place with quite a bit of effort - which is good, because I’m still confident it won’t pop out easily. There was only some minor scratching on the frame that mostly wiped off but it held up just fine, so +1 for durability!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2026
reviews.author: Neal Edgren

reviews.title: Only sunglasses brand I will own!
reviews.body: I already have loved the Goodr brand when it comes to comfort, fit, quality and looks great on me. After this last weekend I will only buy this brand. A member of my group doing the New River Gorge Bridge walk dropped her pair of Goodr sunglasses (800+ ft drop). After dropping a pin in Google Maps and finding them, they were completely intact, and did not have one single scratch.

reviews.author: Kina

reviews.title: Best sunglasses for running, coaching, and everyday wear
reviews.body: I have to give these Goodr sunglasses five stars for quality, affordability, and overall experience.I wear them anytime I know I will be outside and sweating, and they have held up incredibly well through all kinds of activity. They were a staple in my half marathon training during a hot and humid Midwest summer and performed consistently without slipping or becoming uncomfortable.I have purchased more than one pair because I like them so much. I also wear them while coaching cheerleading during Saturday morning football games and honestly could not imagine getting through the season without them. These sunglasses make driving easier as someone with a shorter stature.The fit guidelines are very accurate, which made it easy to choose the right size on the first try. I wear both glasses and contacts and had struggled to find sunglasses that I truly loved until trying these.I will definitely continue purchasing more pairs and switch over to using these exclusively.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 11, 2026
reviews.author: Caitlyn Bailey

reviews.title: Comfy, nonslip with nice lenses!
reviews.body: I have several pairs of Goodr glasses, and so I picked up yet another pair in this nice color combo of white and blue reflective lenses.The order said "v2", but I couldn't find much difference. I think there is an upgrade on the material or hinge? I guess it might feel a little more comfy on my face, but I had chalked that up to just being a new pair and not my old worn down pair that I wear daily.The size of the mediums (OG) is perfect for the average size face. You can even "try on" the glasses on the Goodr website if you aren't sure, but the measurements are a pretty good indicator if you need the regulars or need to change size.Goodr lenses are quality, and have great sun protection, especially with their reflective lenses. The only Goodrs I haven't liked too much are the more "clear" lenses where you can see your eyes clearly through the lenses from the front, but that is just a preference choice, and they have so many options.I'll probably look at picking up another color combo soon. I have about 5 pairs of the "OG" glasses, and they have all been great and super durable. The only thing I have noticed is the frames pickup a lot of grease from my face, especially if I wear sunblock, but I just wipe them down before and after use, and they seem to last forever.I also really like the little carrying case they give you, it doubles as a microfiber cloth. If you want more protection, the box it ships in is a sturdy little cardboard slider box that works very well for protection and storage.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2026
reviews.author: Shopaholic

reviews.title: Love everything about them, except the reflective lenses
reviews.body: Fantastic sunglasses that stay put and don’t slip during sweaty summer runs. No issues so far with them fogging either and they are super easy to wipe clean. Dropped a star specifically for this model with reflective lenses because they scratch too easily, even though I have handled them quite gently. I will definitely buy another pair of Goodrs, just not reflective ones.
